fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Gold paint on the hood, cab and bed sides looks flat and dull rather than glossy
Light grime and road film along the lower doors and rocker area
Chrome front bumper and rear step bumper look dull and spotted
Black step bars and lower trim look faded and dusty
Wheels look dusty with brake and road grime
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the F-250. The gold paint on the hood and cab looks a bit flat, and the chrome bumpers and step bars could use some brightening. We do mobile pre-sale details with a wash, light buff and trim dressing that we bring to you. Would you like a quote?
